mentions.name: Information Domination
mentions.description: An information hub that uses AI agents to compile relevant information from China covering government, economics, and commerce. It currently publishes a daily newsletter fully compiled by AI agents without human intervention, and plans to add public listed companies (semiconductors, energy providers, etc.) to the platform, with data points useful to analysts, researchers, and observers.
mentions.problem: The language barrier stops people from having a better understanding of China.
mentions.audience: Analysts, researchers, or observers who want better understanding of China
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a information hub that utilize AI agents to compile all the relevant information from China (gov, econ, commerce, anything and everything). I call it "information domination".

evidence.value: I'm building a information hub that utilize AI agents to compile all the relevant information from China (gov, econ, commerce, anything and everything). I call it "information domination".
